world_org_meetings.title: EU dropping associate membership title for its closer alliance with Canada
world_org_meetings.description: A joint statement expected to be released at the 21st Canada-EU summit in Montreal on Friday will instead use softer language promising closer ties, according to the latest draft of the statement seen by CBC News.

world_org_meetings.title: Most nations at UN vote to condemn U.S. embargo on Cuba
world_org_meetings.description: The United Nations General Assembly overwhelmingly urged an ‌end to the decades-long U.S. economic embargo on Cuba on Wednesday, but a U.S. lobbying push led several countries to oppose the resolution or abstain for the first time in years.

world_org_meetings.title: Canada-EU summit: What do both sides want, and what’s at stake?
world_org_meetings.description: The EU has proposed to make Canada its first associate member amid tensions over US tariffs.

world_org_meetings.title: U.S. and Cuban officials get into shouting match on floor of United Nations
world_org_meetings.description: U.S. and Cuban officials engaged in a stunning shouting match on the floor of the United Nations General Assembly on Tuesday, the latest in a series of public spats between the longtime adversaries over Washington's escalating economic campaign against Havana.

world_org_meetings.title: Canada needs concrete results from EU summit this week, former envoy says
world_org_meetings.description: Ahead of this week's Canada-European Union summit, Prime Minister Mark Carney said both parties are hammering out a "new, ambitious alliance" after pledging deeper ties with Europe last month.

diplomatic_visits.title: Putin woos African leaders as Moscow seeks to expand footprint in Africa
diplomatic_visits.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin sought to woo African leaders and government delegates on Wednesday as they gathered in Moscow for the third Russia-Africa Summit to discuss trade, security, arms deals and grain supplies as part of the Kremlin's strategic efforts to expand its footprint in Africa.

diplomatic_visits.title: Ethiopia receives 12 Russian Su-35 jets, plans S-400 acquisition
diplomatic_visits.description: PM Abiy Ahmed makes announcement during a Moscow summit as Ethiopia battles armed groups in Tigray and Amhara.

diplomatic_visits.title: Iraqi PM Ali al-Zaidi meets Ahmed al-Sharaa in historic Syria visit
diplomatic_visits.description: Talks focused on enhancing trade, reviving Baniyas oil pipeline and achieving stability through cooperation.

diplomatic_visits.title: Canada, U.A.E. sign defence, energy agreements during crown prince's visit
diplomatic_visits.description: Canada and the United Arab Emirates signed a handful of trade and infrastructure agreements during the crown prince of Abu Dhabi's visit to Ottawa.

diplomatic_visits.title: King Charles confronts calls for slavery apology during Caribbean tour
diplomatic_visits.description: King Charles III began a Caribbean tour in the Bahamas on Tuesday, acknowledging “the great suffering of the past” amid calls for an apology over slavery. The 77-year-old monarch, who is undergoing cancer treatment, will also visit Guyana and Antigua and Barbuda, highlighting climate threats and attending a Commonwealth summit with Queen Camilla.

elections.title: Flávio Bolsonaro lands in Miami after defeat in Brazil's presidential election
elections.description: Bolsonaro's arrival in the US ends speculation about his whereabouts after he failed to comply with an order to surrender his passports.

elections.title: Netanyahu's bloc leading Israel election but short of majority, partial results show
elections.description: With 85% of ballots counted, Netanyahu's Likud party and its allies are set to win 53 seats in the 120-seat Knesset.

elections.title: Netanyahu, Eisenkot stake rival claims to lead Israel after deadlocked vote
elections.description: Emerging results indicated that neither Netanyahu's nor Eisenkot's coalition blocs would reach the 61 seats needed for a majority. Local media projected 53 seats for Likud and allied parties, 48 for Yashar and allied parties and 19 for Arab-led parties.

elections.title: Why the Hispanic vote could sway the outcome of the U.S. midterm elections
elections.description: While millions of U.S. voters have become only more entrenched in their party loyalties in the era of Donald Trump, the large and growing Hispanic community has instead bucked that partisan trend.

elections.title: Will elections in Israel change its Iran approach?
elections.description: As Israelis head to the polls, the country's conflict with Iran casts a long shadow over the ballot box. But any leadership changes in Israel may not be enough to shake up its grand strategy on Tehran.
